historical_record.description: Greystar took over the stalled redevelopment of this corner from 4Terra Investments. Public Works issued street and sidewalk closure permits with an October 19 start date, for an eight-storey, 85-foot building designed by BDE Architecture. The site last held the Touchless Car Wash, which closed in 2019.
historical_record.headline: Greystar Takes Over Stalled 400 Divisadero Site, 203 Units Finally Break Ground

unknowns: The redevelopment reported here covers five merged assessor lots at the northeast corner of Divisadero and Oak; this page documents the parcel addressed 400 Divisadero. The site is given as 0.93 acres by SF Planning and as 0.79 acres in another account.
